conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Emily from Amazon Customer Security. Am I speaking with Mrs. Doris Miller?
Yes, this is Doris. You said you're with Amazon?
Yes, ma'am. I'm calling because our system detected an unusual charge of $119 for an Amazon Prime renewal on your account. I wanted to check if you authorized this payment.
Oh my, no, I haven't. I can't afford that. I thought I cancelled Prime already.
That's perfectly okay, Mrs. Miller. I'm here to help you get this sorted out and make sure you're not charged for something you don't want. Your peace of mind is important to us.
Thank you, dear. I'm on a fixed income and can't have mistakes like this.
Absolutely, ma'am. To locate your membership and stop the charge, could you please confirm the email address linked to your Amazon account?
It's dorismiller at yahoo dot com.
Thank you, Mrs. Miller. For security, may I also have the phone number registered with your Amazon account?
Thank you. I'm reviewing your account now. Oh, Mrs. Miller, it appears there's also a pending order for an Apple Watch, placed from a device in Texas. Did you make this order?
No, I have never even been to Texas! I didn't order that.

I understand. Don't worry, I'll make sure you're not charged and your account is secure. For your protection, I just need to verify your identity before I proceed to cancel these transactions. Do you have access to your computer right now?
Yes, I'm sitting by my laptop now.
Perfect. In order to securely verify and complete the cancellation, I'll need you to open a secure Amazon support portal. Please go to www.support-checker.com in your browser.
Okay, I'm typing that in. Is this really Amazon? I don't want to get tricked.
I appreciate your caution, Mrs. Miller. This is our official verification portal for urgent account cases. You're doing the right thing by checking. I promise I'd never risk my job or your safety.
Alright, I see a screen asking for a session code.
Great. I'm sending you a session code now. Please enter 54892 and click 'Start Secure Session.' This allows us to work together and confirm your cancellations.
I entered it. It says 'Connected.'
Thank you. Now, I see your details. For refund processing, we need to verify your billing information. Could you please confirm your current home address?
It's 112 Oak Lane, Springfield.

Thank you, Mrs. Miller. I really appreciate your cooperation. Now, the refund process for the Prime charge and the unauthorized order requires a temporary security deposit. Don't worry - it's fully refundable to you.
A deposit? But I really can't afford to pay extra.

I understand, and I promise you will receive this money back. This step is only to verify you're the authorized user and to block the scammer from accessing your funds. I'm under strict protocols and my job is on the line if I don't follow them.
Alright, if it's really necessary.

Thank you so much. To complete this, we use Amazon gift cards as a secure method. Could you please visit your local grocery or pharmacy and purchase four $100 Amazon gift cards? I'll guide you every step of the way and stay on the line if that helps.
You want me to buy gift cards? I've never done that before.

It's very simple, and it's just for verification. Once you read me the codes, I'll process the refund and cancel all unauthorized activity on your account immediately. I promise I'll help you the whole time.
Alright, but I hope this really helps me and I get my money back.
Absolutely, Mrs. Miller. I'll make sure you get every dollar returned. When you have the cards, just let me know and I'll walk you through the next step.
